_description: Evaluate a produced priority function on Procedure 2 heldout data and compare against optional baselines.

_field_docs.prio_function_path: Python file containing the priority function to evaluate.
_field_docs.training_pickle_path: One .pkl path or a JSON array of .pkl paths. All listed DataFrames are concatenated to form the oracle-training dataset.
_field_docs.calibrating_pickle_path: One .pkl path or a JSON array of .pkl paths. All listed DataFrames are concatenated to form the calibration dataset.
_field_docs.heldout_pickle_path: One .pkl path or a JSON array of .pkl paths. All listed DataFrames are concatenated to form the heldout evaluation dataset.
_field_docs.output_row_tracking_path: Path to output_row_tracking.pkl used to recover ancestry groups for heldout rows.
_field_docs.report_file_name: File name for the saved clean JSON report. It is written in the same directory as prio_function_path.
_field_docs.supported_ancestry_groups: Allowed ancestry codes when parsing source shard names from output_row_tracking.pkl.
_field_docs.should_overwrite: If true, overwrite any existing report for this priority function. If false, reuse an existing report and compute only configured baselines that are missing from it.
_field_docs.function_name: Function name to load from prio_function_path.
_field_docs.calibration_penalties: Penalty values searched when fitting the final calibration model.
_field_docs.calibration_partitions: Worker count for calibration feature building or auto.
_field_docs.scoring_partitions: Worker count for heldout feature building or auto.
_field_docs.baselines: Optional baseline models to evaluate on the same heldout dataset.
